alt: Sandals and flip-flops left in rows on a doorstep, seen from above. A ginger and white cat sits among them, washing one paw.
Three children playing in front of a pale blue house. A girl in pink is caught mid-jump above the yard while a boy runs along the veranda behind her.
Children playing a throwing game with their sandals on a concrete yard. Two boys lean forward mid-throw while a girl crouches beside the bottle they are aiming at.
An arm reaches in from the right to turn a key in the lock of a red wooden door.
Two hands meet over a market table as money changes hands. A man in sunglasses stands at the stall and the seller sits behind it in a white headscarf.
A vegetable seller sits behind his stall, framed from the chest down. Long beans and bitter gourd are spread on foil in front of him with handwritten price cards.
An older woman in a lace headscarf stands behind her market table, greens and aubergines laid out with handwritten price cards.
A couple walking through the market, photographed from the waist down, their hands just meeting between them. The stall behind is numbered 58.
A close-up of my wife's eye. Palm trees and the figure taking the photograph are reflected in the iris.
A white stone Buddha in a temple garden, one hand raised in teaching, with disciples seated around him. Paper lanterns hang from the trees above.
Four dogs on a tiled lane. A small brown one stands in the middle of the frame looking up, and a shaggy grey one crowds the lens at the right edge.
Three men at a pavement cafe table. One plays a guitar while the other two look at their phones.
Concrete graves set among banana palms and coffee bushes, with a village and green hills beyond.
A timber house in Vietnam with blue doors and shutters, a bed of flowers along its front, farmland on either side and mist on the hills behind.
A flatbed truck loaded high with green coconuts, parked at the roadside under a palm.
A girl stands in the doorway of a house, a woman behind her in the dark of the hall. Sandals lie on the bare ground outside.
A woman in a yellow dress standing on the low branch of a mango tree, her face hidden by the leaves.
The same mango tree a moment later. She has moved further along the branch, barefoot now, her face just visible through the leaves.
A small wooden church with a narrow steeple, seen from across the road under power lines and a heavy sky.
A large white wooden church with a steep gable and a square bell tower, palms in the foreground.
A church gate seen from below. The iron arch above it reads “Jezus zegt komt herwaarts tot mij”.
Dawn at Leonsberg. A long exposure smooths the river around the pilings of a broken jetty.
A woman walking towards the camera past shuttered shopfronts in Paramaribo, looking straight into the lens. Two people rest in a doorway behind her.
Three women waiting beside a minibus on a Paramaribo street. The nearest looks at the camera as she eats.
A woman leans out of a minibus window, laughing, her arm resting along the sill.
A clothes seller in a cap works under the market awning, customers crowding the stall around him.
Two minibuses at a bus stand. Beside one, a woman reaches up to the window to speak to a passenger while another waits with their bags on the ground.
A pickup parked in front of a two-storey wooden house, half of it painted dark and half left bare, with long grass across the yard.
Three women walk past shuttered shopfronts, under a shop sign reading Kotomisie.
A Toyota minibus at the kerb, its windows and side hand-lettered with names, the door standing open.
Dawn at the pier. A man walks down the jetty towards a boat while another leans out over the water, pulling it in by a rope.
A small girl walks off the pier holding a hand on either side of her, her family close around.
Three people on the pier at Leonsberg turn to look back at the camera, moored boats behind them.
Two women talking on the pier at Leonsberg, one with her back to the camera in a bold floral blouse, the other facing her with her hair loose in the wind.
A litter bin leaning against a post at the edge of the tarmac, the ground around it bare and scuffed.
A man in a striped shirt and sun hat waits at the end of the pier with his bag, the river smooth behind him.
A woman in a conical hat sits in the bow of a sampan as it moves down a narrow channel through the nipa palms, in the Mekong Delta.
A woman in a red hat cycles past a street eatery, a bag of shopping in her front basket.
Seen through a gap in a dark stone railing: a woman stands with her hands joined before a white statue, marigolds crowding the opening.
Scooters packed at a red light in Saigon at dusk, helmets and tail lights filling the frame.
A scooter blurs past an empty cafe terrace at night, strung with bulbs under pink blossom.
An older man lies back across his motorbike at the kerb, feet bare, sandals on the pavement beside him.
An older man sits shirtless on a plastic chair in front of a green shutter, one hand resting on the bowl on his table.
Lady helps kids get their ball back from the sunscreen
A woman kneels barefoot before a white statue of Quan Am, incense burning in the urn between them.
Motorbikes come down a road in My Tho, shophouses on both sides and a vendor resting in the shade at the left.
Chicken on back of motorcycle with kid woman and man
A woman lifts a shoulder pole with two flat baskets of sweet potatoes and greens, crouched in the middle of an empty junction at first light.
A woman in a conical hat leans at a barred shop hatch, the shopkeeper behind the grille, a faded Coca-Cola poster on the blue shutter beside her.
A schoolgirl in uniform sits on a doorstep in a narrow alley, arms folded across her knees, looking straight at the camera.
A lottery seller waits in a folding chair behind his rack of tickets, his motorbike parked against a graffitied wall.
A white dog stands on the seat of a scooter outside a shop while two darker dogs wait behind it and the shopkeeper reaches up to his shelves.
A hat seller leans against a tree holding a painted conical hat, his bicycle beside him hung with more, and a rail of caps along the kerb.
Two men sit out on the pavement. One holds a bag of feed while two quail perch on his knee, taking it from his fingers.
A woman stands at a stone urn crowded with incense sticks, smoke filling the temple courtyard around her.
An older couple wait at the kerb with their shopping, a scooter blurring past on the boulevard behind them.
An older woman rides towards the camera through traffic, her load strapped in front, while a woman behind her looks up and is caught mid-smile.
A dog lies on the tiles of a shaded veranda while a man sits at the table behind it with his back to the camera.
A woman in a conical hat stands close to the camera at a wide junction, her face in shadow under the brim, with a hatched triangle painted on the road behind her.
A young man hoses down a scooter under an awning, the spray catching the sun across the wet forecourt.
A man in a white jacket walks out of the dark of a market with a bag in his hand, caught in a shaft of light.
Hard working man pushing load at market in Vietnam
A man in a white cap walks past a hardware shop, its front stacked to the ceiling with baskets, buckets, fans and a rubber ring.
An older man in a suit and straw hat clears glasses from a cafe table, two younger men watching from the bench behind.
A man in a dark suit and open collar stands smiling against a graffitied wall.
A woman in a bucket hat passes a wall hung with old tyres and pots planted with greenery, her face in profile against the light.
A phone repairer works under a head lamp at a bench crowded with tools, screens and cables.
Two children play-fighting on stone steps, seen from directly overhead, one lunging at the other.
A woman stands with her hands on her hips in the one patch of light at the end of a dark alley, watching the street beyond.
A man stands at the top of a flight of steps in low sun, his shadow stretching back across the patterned paving towards the camera.
A barista pours from a gooseneck kettle into a filter cone, his shadow thrown large on the wall behind.
Old couple working out in the morning in Vietnam
A shirtless man walks away down the pavement carrying a small white dog, which looks back over his shoulder at the camera.
A woman in a conical hat climbs a flight of steps with her bags, bent under the weight, while a man waits at the top. Late sun falls across the stone.
Two women embrace on a shop arcade in Paramaribo. A third sits to one side with her phone, beside a table of stacked bowls and trays of produce.
Brass players in matching sashes on Onafhankelijkheidsplein, the clock tower behind them and a crowd around the tents.
A young woman dances through a line of drummers in white, sticks raised, on Onafhankelijkheidsplein.
Women in white on a street corner near the Palmentuin, one checking her phone, another facing them in a pompom headdress.
Black and white photograph of a horse statue on a wooded mound in a park, people resting on a bench below.
The pier at Leonsberg at sunset, a covered boat moored alongside and the jetty running out into the river.
Black and white photograph of a girl looking at her phone at a market stall, a woman with a tray of goods beside her.
Black and white photograph of minibuses queued on a street, backlit by low morning sun.
Black and white photograph of two women talking across a market stall piled with coconuts and vegetables.
Black and white photograph of shoppers at a market stall, a child peeking over a pile of chili peppers.
Black and white photograph of a woman in a headwrap crossing a street at dusk, motorbikes passing on either side.
Black and white photograph of passengers stepping off a small ferry onto a muddy riverbank.
Black and white photograph of two women walking past each other on a street, one glancing back over her shoulder.
Black and white photograph of a woman wearing headphones walking past a pharmacy sign reading Apotheek Esculaap.
Black and white photograph of a man sitting on a chair outside a shopfront, another man walking toward the camera.
Black and white photograph of women walking through an outdoor market between rows of covered stalls.
Black and white photograph of a woman under a large black umbrella on a sunlit street.
Sunrise over a hillside homestay in D'ran, Vietnam, mist lying in the valley below and a contrail crossing the sky.
Color photograph of two men on motorbikes stopped beside a street food cart, under a red PHOTO shop sign.
Color photograph of a shirtless man pulling a checked shirt over his head, seen through a market doorway.
Color photograph of roadside drink and noodle stalls under palm trees, a Vietnamese flag flying above.
A woman in a conical hat walks past a blue house in D'ran, Vietnam, carrying her shopping through the early light.
Color photograph of moored fishing boats strung with small Vietnamese flags, two people working on deck.
Color photograph of a man standing on a beach under a large umbrella, a striped deck chair beside him.
Black and white photograph of a man reading a book at a cafe table, a standing fan and bookshelves behind him.
Black and white photograph of an older man sitting on a doorstep in a narrow alley, a pho restaurant sign behind him.
Black and white photograph of a man standing by a gate with a house number sign reading 47 Au Co, palm trees behind him.
Black and white photograph of two young men fishing from a riverside promenade, boats moored across the water.
Black and white photograph of a woman in a knitted hat grilling meat on a street-side barbecue, smoke rising.
Black and white photograph of a woman in a conical hat laughing beside a market cart piled with vegetables.
Black and white photograph of a man crouched beside baskets of oranges at a market, a cigarette in his mouth.
Black and white photograph of two women with their hair in buns, standing close together in low light.
Black and white photograph of four men sitting outside a shop, one wearing a painted mask, another making a hand gesture.
